item.text:
| Item | Result | Source-based reasoning |
|---|---:|---|
| 1. `unit_word_t` packed width | 9 bits | It is declared while ``WORD_W`` is 9: `logic [8:0]` ([environment.sv:4](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/unit_macros/text-only/rep_1/workspace/rtl/environment.sv:4)). The later macro redefinition does not alter an already-declared typedef. |
| 2. Effective top `W` | 13 | The top declaration’s default is ``WORD_W`` ([top.sv:6](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/unit_macros/text-only/rep_1/workspace/rtl/top.sv:6)). In the single CU, `channel.sv` changes it to 13 ([channel.sv:2-3](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/unit_macros/text-only/rep_1/workspace/rtl/channel.sv:2)); the guarded include in `top.sv` does not reset it. No top instance override was specified. |
| 3. Effective top `N` | 3 | Top declares default ``LANES`` ([top.sv:7](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/unit_macros/text-only/rep_1/workspace/rtl/top.sv:7)) and locally redefines it to 3 before the module declaration ([top.sv:2-3](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/unit_macros/text-only/rep_1/workspace/rtl/top.sv:2)). |
| 4. Width of top `data_i` | 39 bits | Its range is `[W*N-1:0]` ([top.sv:9](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/unit_macros/text-only/rep_1/workspace/rtl/top.sv:9)); with `W=13`, `N=3`, that is `[38:0]`. |
| 5. Effective instantiated-channel `W` | 15 | `channel` declares a default of 13 ([channel.sv:5-7](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/unit_macros/text-only/rep_1/workspace/rtl/channel.sv:5)), but `g_wide.u_channel` explicitly overrides it with `.W(W+2)` ([top.sv:14](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/unit_macros/text-only/rep_1/workspace/rtl/top.sv:14)): `13+2=15`. |
| 6. Width of that `payload_i` | 15 bits | The channel port is `[W-1:0]` ([channel.sv:9](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/unit_macros/text-only/rep_1/workspace/rtl/channel.sv:9)); instantiated `W` is 15. The connected slice `data_i[W+1:0]` is `[14:0]`, also 15 bits ([top.sv:16](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/unit_macros/text-only/rep_1/workspace/rtl/top.sv:16)). |
| 7. Active generate branch / path | `g_wide`; `unit_macros_top.g_wide.u_channel` | `$bits(unit_word_t)=9`, so `W > $bits(unit_word_t)` is `13 > 9`, true ([top.sv:13-19](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/unit_macros/text-only/rep_1/workspace/rtl/top.sv:13)). |
| 8. Separate compilation units preserve this design? | No | In the specified one-CU order, `settings.svh`’s guard is set by the first inclusion ([settings.svh:1-5](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/unit_macros/text-only/rep_1/workspace/rtl/settings.svh:1)); later includes are skipped. Thus channel’s `WORD_W=13` remains visible to top, while `unit_word_t` remains the earlier 9-bit typedef. If each file were a separate CU, macro state and `$unit` declarations would not carry across them: `channel.sv` and `top.sv` would not see `unit_word_t` declared in `environment.sv`, making their unqualified type references invalid. Independently, top would freshly include the header and see `WORD_W=9`, not channel’s 13, so its elaboration would also differ. |

The important default/override distinction is that the channel declaration default is 13, but the actual `u_channel` instance explicitly overrides it to 15.
